articles.summary: Independence Realty Trust, Inc. (“IRT”) (NYSE: IRT), announces the publication of its 2024 Sustainability Report, which can be accessed by going to visit https://investors.irtliving.com/sustainability/ . The report summarizes IRT’s sustainability achievements through calendar year 2024 as part of the company’s broader mission to provide exceptional living experiences for residents and attractive returns for shareholders. “We believe that operating multifamily real estate communities can be conducted with a conscious regard for the environment and wider society, while also benefiting our business success and long-term value creation for our residents, associates and investors,” said Scott Schaeffer, Chairman and CEO. He continued, “Our core values are integrated into each of the four pillars of our sustainability strategy, which are enhancing residential living, supporting our associates, managing our environmental impact, and promoting good governance.” About IRT Independence Realty
articles.title: Independence Realty Trust Publishes 2024 Sustainability Report
